suggestion.title: New jutsu icon
suggestion.rationale: New icon from the director-approved starter jutsu icon set.

New icon: spectral chains shooting forward into a wisp of soul flame, matching a cursed technique that strikes in a straight line and tears through the enemy's spirit. It replaces the old small scene of a posing ninja, which was hard to read at small sizes.
